search_radius_m.description: half-width of the initial pose search window

grid_points.description: candidates per axis per search pass

max_speed_mps.description: Implausible-jump speed bound (m/s): a pose update implying more than this is discarded and the prior pose kept; ~1.5x the closed-loop ceiling.

jump_confirm_tolerance_m.description: how close two consecutive rejected candidates must be to confirm a real correction

relocalize_cost_threshold.description: Mean clipped squared residual (m^2, real returns only) at which a scan counts as not explaining the pose, arming global relocalization.

relocalize_after_scans.description: consecutive bad scans before re-solving globally (~1.5 s)

relocalize_grid_step_m.description: free-space candidate spacing for the global search

relocalize_accept_ratio.description: Fraction of the local cost the global fit must beat before it replaces the local pose; otherwise the wall model is presumed wrong.
